edges.notes: Argo CD runs on Kubernetes and applies Git-declared desired state to the cluster via controllers and CRDs.
Argo CD supports Helm charts as an application source type per upstream documentation.
Applications reference container images pulled as OCI images in typical deployments.
OCI Helm charts and container images are often sourced from registries using distribution-class HTTP APIs.
Argo CD supports Kustomize as an application source type per upstream documentation.
Substitutable GitOps controller class for Kubernetes continuous delivery; different architecture and UX than Flux.
